Bill.BriefDescription: Changing provisions relating to bail bond recovery agents.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to bail bond recovery agents; and amending RCW18.185.300.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecAmd.BegSecText: RCW 18.185.300 and 2004 c 186 s 12 are each amended toread as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) Before a bail bond recovery agent may apprehend a personsubject to a bail bond in a planned forced entry, the bail bondrecovery agent must notify an appropriate law enforcement agency in thelocal jurisdiction in which the apprehension is expected to occur.Notification must include, at a minimum: The name of the defendant;the address, or the approximate location if the address isundeterminable, of the dwelling, building, or other structure where theplanned forced entry is expected to occur; the name of the bail bondrecovery agent; the name of the contracting bail bond agent; and thealleged offense or conduct the defendant committed that resulted in theissuance of a bail bond. (2) During the actual planned forced entry, a bail bond recoveryagent may wear either: p. 1 SB 5726 (a) ((Shall wear)) A shirt, vest, or other garment with the words"BAIL BOND RECOVERY AGENT" displayed in at least ((two)) oneinchhighreflective print letters across the front and back of the garment andin a contrasting color to that of the garment; ((and)) or (b) A shirt, vest, or other garment with the words "BAILENFORCEMENT AGENT" displayed in at least oneinchhigh reflective printletters across the front and back of the garment and in a contrastingcolor to that of the garment. (3) During the actual planned forced entry, a bail bond recoveryagent may display a badge approved by the department with the words"BAIL BOND RECOVERY AGENT" prominently displayed.
